collections.purpose: A suggested path through six short labs.
collections.coverage: Original simulations of selected Linux navigation, permissions and service tasks.

collections.purpose: Build confidence finding files and controlling ordinary file and directory access.
collections.sequence: Recommended order: navigation, file access, directory access, private files, search-only access, then handover practice. Start any lab; nothing is locked.
collections.prerequisites: Beginner friendly. Start with navigation if paths are new to you; the final handover reinforces earlier directory skills.
collections.coverage: LPIC-1 objectives v5.0: introductory shell/path practice (103.1/103.3 preparation) and partial 104.5 permissions coverage. Not full LPIC-1 preparation: no shell processing, ownership changes, special bits or umask. Original content; no LPI affiliation.
